'''Ohann''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|stars]] [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. Located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], it was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. It was the largest out of the three planets in the Tatoo system.

[[Drone barge/Legends|Drone barges]] were used to ferry [[Water/Legends|ice]] blocks<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> from [[Ohann's ice rings]]. The [[free-trader]] [[Garouf Lafoe/Legends|Garouf Lafoe]] imported ice from Adriana's rings to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CCG-Lafoe" />
